# ============================================================================
# Sound Creations Ltd - security + performance
# Updated: 2026-09-28
#
# NOTES FOR FUTURE EDITORS:
#  - Do NOT edit inside the BEGIN/END WordPress or BEGIN/END seraphinite
#    markers. Both are regenerated automatically and your changes will be lost.
#  - Security headers below are scoped to STATIC FILES ONLY. PHP pages already
#    get them from the theme (soundcreations/inc/hardening.php). Do not add
#    them globally here or every page will send them twice.
#  - XML-RPC is already disabled in PHP, so it is not repeated here.
# ============================================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Legacy /newwebsite/ redirects  --  the site moved to the domain root.
#    Preserves Google rankings and keeps old inbound links alive.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
RewriteEngine On

RewriteRule ^newwebsite/?$ / [R=301,L]
RewriteRule ^newwebsite/(.*)$ /$1 [R=301,L]

# Canonical HTTPS. The second condition keeps this safe behind a proxy or CDN
# (without it, some hosts loop forever).
RewriteCond %{HTTPS} !=on
RewriteCond %{HTTP:X-Forwarded-Proto} !=https
RewriteRule ^ https://%{HTTP_HOST}%{REQUEST_URI} [L,R=301]
</IfModule>

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Compression. Already active on this server; kept as a safety net so
#    compression survives a plugin being disabled. Apache skips anything that
#    already carries a Content-Encoding, so this cannot double-compress.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
<IfModule mod_deflate.c>
  AddOutputFilterByType DEFLATE text/html text/plain text/xml text/css
  AddOutputFilterByType DEFLATE application/javascript application/x-javascript
  AddOutputFilterByType DEFLATE application/json application/xml
  AddOutputFilterByType DEFLATE image/svg+xml
</IfModule>

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Browser caching  --  THE MAIN PERFORMANCE FIX.
#    Static assets currently ship with no cache headers at all, so repeat
#    visitors re-download every stylesheet, script, font and image.
#
#    One year is safe for theme assets: the theme cache-busts automatically
#    using the filemtime of main.css, so an edit produces a new URL.
#    Video is deliberately shorter - see the note under section 3b.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
<IfModule mod_expires.c>
  ExpiresActive On

  ExpiresByType text/css                "access plus 1 year"
  ExpiresByType application/javascript  "access plus 1 year"
  ExpiresByType text/javascript         "access plus 1 year"

  ExpiresByType image/jpeg              "access plus 180 days"
  ExpiresByType image/png               "access plus 180 days"
  ExpiresByType image/gif               "access plus 180 days"
  ExpiresByType image/webp              "access plus 180 days"
  ExpiresByType image/svg+xml           "access plus 180 days"
  ExpiresByType image/x-icon            "access plus 180 days"

  ExpiresByType font/woff2              "access plus 1 year"
  ExpiresByType font/woff               "access plus 1 year"
  ExpiresByType application/font-woff2  "access plus 1 year"

  # Shorter on purpose: the hero video is due to be re-encoded and re-uploaded
  # over the same filename. A 1-year cache would leave visitors stuck on the
  # old 22MB copy. Raise this to 1 year once the video is final.
  ExpiresByType video/mp4               "access plus 1 month"

  # Never cache the HTML itself - page caching is seraphinite's job.
  ExpiresByType text/html               "access plus 0 seconds"
</IfModule>

<IfModule mod_headers.c>
  <FilesMatch "\.(css|js|woff|woff2)$">
    Header set Cache-Control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable"
  </FilesMatch>

  # Images: 180 days, not immutable. Theme images and replaced media keep
  # the same filename, so a 1-year immutable cache hides updated photos.
  <FilesMatch "\.(jpg|jpeg|png|gif|webp|svg|ico)$">
    Header set Cache-Control "public, max-age=15552000"
  </FilesMatch>

  <FilesMatch "\.mp4$">
    Header set Cache-Control "public, max-age=2592000"
  </FilesMatch>

  # Cookies are pointless on static files and block some proxy caches.
  <FilesMatch "\.(css|js|jpg|jpeg|png|gif|webp|svg|ico|woff|woff2|mp4)$">
    Header unset Set-Cookie
  </FilesMatch>
</IfModule>

# Validators that work on shared/load-balanced hosting (inode-free).
FileETag MTime Size

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Security headers for STATIC ASSETS ONLY.
#    PHP pages already receive these from the theme - see note at top.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
<IfModule mod_headers.c>
  <FilesMatch "\.(css|js|jpg|jpeg|png|gif|webp|svg|ico|woff|woff2|mp4)$">
    Header set X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff"
    Header set Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
    Header always set Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains"
  </FilesMatch>
</IfModule>

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. File protection
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Options -Indexes
ServerSignature Off

<FilesMatch "^(wp-config\.php|\.htaccess|\.htpasswd|readme\.html|license\.txt|debug\.log|error_log)$">
  Require all denied
</FilesMatch>

<FilesMatch "\.(bak|old|orig|save|swp|sql|log|ini|sh)$">
  Require all denied
</FilesMatch>

# Hidden files (.git, .env), but keep .well-known working for SSL renewal.
RedirectMatch 404 /\.(?!well-known)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Correct MIME types, so the caching and compression rules above match.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
<IfModule mod_mime.c>
  AddType image/webp                 .webp
  AddType font/woff2                 .woff2
  AddType video/mp4                  .mp4
  AddType image/svg+xml              .svg
  AddType application/x-web-app-manifest+json .webapp
</IfModule>

# BEGIN WordPress
# The directives (lines) between "BEGIN WordPress" and "END WordPress" are
# dynamically generated, and should only be modified via WordPress filters.
# Any changes to the directives between these markers will be overwritten.
<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
RewriteEngine On
RewriteRule .* - [E=HTTP_AUTHORIZATION:%{HTTP:Authorization}]
RewriteBase /
RewriteRule ^index\.php$ - [L]
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-f
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-d
RewriteRule . /index.php [L]
</IfModule>

# END WordPress
# BEGIN seraphinite-accelerator
# The directives (lines) between "BEGIN seraphinite-accelerator" and "END seraphinite-accelerator" are
# dynamically generated, and should only be modified via WordPress filters.
# Any changes to the directives between these markers will be overwritten.

# END seraphinite-accelerator

# php -- BEGIN cPanel-generated handler, do not edit
# Set the "ea-php80" package as the default "PHP" programming language.
<IfModule mime_module>
  AddHandler application/x-httpd-ea-php80___lsphp .php .php8 .phtml
</IfModule>
# php -- END cPanel-generated handler, do not edit
